results.title: Low-randomness dense-source tensor algorithms
results.question: Construct explicit polylogarithmic-seed source samplers whose output tensors admit P18-type all-target algorithms and have provable resistance to concentration on a few isomorphism classes.
results.result: Explicit dense polylog-seed sampler with exact orbit dispersion and an all-target orthogonal algorithm over F5.

results.title: Matrix-space equivalence with supplied full-rank anchor
results.question: Give a bit-polynomial algorithm for left-right equivalence of arbitrary matrix spaces supplied with matched invertible anchors, while retaining unknown mixing of all other matrices.
results.result: TI-complete even with matched invertible anchors, so a polynomial algorithm here would give one for ordinary TI.

results.title: Singular alternating-space pseudo-isometry
results.question: Give polynomial-time pseudo-isometry for alternating spaces whose Pfaffian is identically zero but whose common radical is zero, without assuming bounded matrix-space dimension.
results.result: The singular, common-radical-zero promise is polynomially equivalent to unrestricted alternating-space pseudo-isometry.

results.title: Matrix spaces with identical generated algebras
results.question: Find efficient equivalence algorithms for matrix spaces that generate the same full matrix algebra but differ only in the embedded generating subspace, beyond ordered-generator conjugacy.
results.result: TI-complete even for matrix spaces generating the same full algebra, with either conjugation or left-right equivalence.

results.title: Simultaneous code duality witnesses
results.question: Given a short list of codes of matching lengths and dimensions, find one monomial transformation taking each code to its corresponding dual whenever possible. Determine the complexity with a promise that each code is individually isodual.
results.result: Monomial code-equivalence complete with one target instance, already for three individually isodual codes.

results.title: Orbit distance to a self-orthogonal code
results.question: Determine the minimum number of coordinates to puncture from a given code before its monomial orbit meets the Euclidean self-orthogonal locus. Classify approximability or parameterized complexity in the number of punctures.
results.result: The binary problem is NP-complete, parameterized equivalent to binary k-VectorSum, and has no PTAS unless P = NP.

results.title: Epimorphism under large central sections
results.question: Find a polynomial algorithm or hardness classification for onto homomorphisms with fixed quotient action between central extensions whose central sections are varying-exponent abelian p-groups.
results.result: Polynomial-time onto lifting with prescribed quotient action, arbitrary abelian p-power central heights, and explicit compact coordinates.

results.title: Succinct quotient testing for odd class-two groups
results.question: Classify deterministic polynomial-bit-time epimorphism testing on alternating-bimap presentations of exponent-p class-two groups, for fixed odd p and unbounded dimensions.
results.result: NP-complete to test surjection onto the fixed Heisenberg group of order p³ for every fixed odd prime p.

results.title: Approximation for maximum class-two quotient rank
results.question: For odd prime p, given a class-two exponent-p group by an alternating presentation and a target bimap, approximate the largest quotient of the target also admitting an epimorphism from the source, measured in log_p order.
results.result: Sharp 3/2 approximation for the fixed Heisenberg target. General targets rule out every ratio below 2 and every fixed additive error unless P = NP.

results.title: Homomorphism extension with bounded generator-image ambiguity
results.question: Given a map on M≤G and for each selected generator outside M a coset in the target permutation group as its image domain, classify extendibility with bounded index and variable cosets.
results.result: Coset-constrained homomorphism extension is NP-complete at index two with one mark, and polynomial at index one.

results.title: Subgroup conjugacy through an intrinsic Lie filtration
results.question: For class-c
results.result: Bit-polynomial subgroup conjugacy for compact class-c p-group presentations with c below p.

results.title: Minimal common central-product ambient group
results.question: Given compact class-two groups and specified embeddings of their centers into a common elementary abelian space, find the smallest order of a class-two group simultaneously admitting these central embeddings and both specified subgroups.
results.result: Exact minimum ambient-order formula for the prescribed central gluings, with NP-complete compact threshold decision.

results.title: Sparsity-to-ROABP hardness lifting
results.question: Identify a uniform substitution gadget whose composition with a polynomial of sparsity s forces ROABP size Ω(s) in every order, with overhead controlled by the original parameters.
results.result: One explicit substitution forces middle ROABP width exactly equal to input sparsity in every order and over any field.

results.title: Newton-polytope summands from arithmetic circuits
results.question: Given a polynomial-size circuit whose Newton polytope is known to be a nontrivial Minkowski sum, find one primitive lattice summand in time polynomial in the circuit size and vertex output length under an explicit promise of a polynomial-size output.
results.result: Polynomial-time primitive summand search would imply P = NP even for explicit bivariate vertex-monomial circuits with polynomial-size promised output.

results.title: Unsatisfiable CNF families whose equation maps hit restricted circuits
results.question: For explicit classes Λ with known hitting sets, construct an unsatisfiable 3-CNF family whose clause-and-Boolean equation map has image hitting every nonzero polynomial from Λ in the equation variables.
results.result: Uniform unsatisfiable 3-CNFs hit all quadratic polynomials in the equation coordinates, with a universal degree-12 obstruction for larger classes.

results.title: Formula-order witness reconstruction
results.question: Given a black box for a promised read-once rational formula over arbitrarily grouped affine linear forms on disjoint unknown input sets, reconstruct such a grouping and formula with polynomial bit complexity including coefficient sizes.
results.result: Deterministic bit-polynomial black-box reconstruction of a grouped read-once rational formula, allowing singleton output groups.

results.title: Derivative-space hitting sets in fixed small characteristic
results.question: Can explicit hitting sets of size poly(n,d,r) hit degree-d polynomials over a prescribed fixed finite field when the span of all Hasse derivatives has dimension r, permitting polynomial-degree extensions for evaluations?
results.result: Explicit polynomial-size Hasse derivative hitting sets over every fixed finite field, with a logarithmic-degree evaluation extension.

results.title: Characteristic-sensitive degree in degeneration versus isomorphism
results.question: Can explicit concise geometrically nonisomorphic tensors whose orbit closures meet require provably larger PC refutation degree than equally formatted examples whose orbit closures are disjoint over a fixed finite field?
results.result: Ordinary GL orbit closures always meet. In the SL version, concise tensors separate linear from constant PC degree at identical cubic formats.

results.title: Automorphism-aware approximate counting for rare motifs
results.question: Give a relative-error approximation scheme for counts of an induced motif under a promise on host rank-width and positive count, with fixed-parameter dependence on motif size and rank-width and near-linear host dependence.
results.result: Exact counts for supplied bounded rank-width with fixed-parameter dependence and almost-linear host dependence.

results.title: Streaming motif frequency with rooted-type compression
results.question: Determine the memory needed to estimate connected induced motif frequencies on graph streams with an explicit bound on the number of pendant rooted tree types.
results.result: Tight quadratic-bit one-pass adversarial insertion-only space on fixed triangles, even with zero pendant types.

results.title: Dynamic subtree catalogs for graph motifs
results.question: Maintain exact induced motif counts under single-edge edits that preserve a bounded-size core and at most k distinct rooted attachment types, with update time independent of host order up to polylogarithmic factors.
results.result: Exact dynamic motif counting in logarithmic amortized updates for bounded core size and fixed motif.

results.title: Canonical comparison for weighted rooted motifs
results.question: Give a parameter-uniform algorithm to reuse isomorphic weighted or directed rooted subtrees while computing exact induced motif counts over graph classes with sparse directed cores.
results.result: Canonical reuse of weighted and directed pendant rooted attachments via relative-boundary pattern tables.

results.title: Surface Unique Games for restricted nonabelian actions
results.question: Characterize which transitive actions of a fixed finite nonabelian group yield NP-hard constant-factor minimization of violated edge constraints on triangulations of closed orientable surfaces.
results.result: Fixed transitive actions have a hard constant-factor gap on flat triangulated surfaces exactly when the alphabet has more than one point.

results.title: Bounded-degree triangulations and exact gap transfer
results.question: Can gap instances for minimum violated permutations be compiled into closed orientable surface triangulations of uniformly bounded vertex degree with preservation of a fixed nonabelian label action?
results.result: Exact factor-six optimum transfer into uniformly bounded-degree closed orientable flat triangulations using the original action.

results.title: Persistently robust generators with thin incidence structure
results.question: Find a parameterized algorithm or hardness classification for the minimum deletions needed to kill a prescribed positive-dimensional persistence class when the complex is given by a bounded-width incidence decomposition.
results.result: An exact fixed-parameter algorithm in incidence width at each fixed finite field for persistence-class deletion.

GP-0112.result: Dicke entropy law, including repeated species. This packet also gives the coefficient-one all-field transfer.

GP-0114.result: A four-mode counterexample to irreducibility of all asymptotic-rank sublevels.

GP-0197.result: An explicit family of secants of three-factor Segre varieties that fail S2 and Cohen–Macaulayness.

GP-0232.result: Already classified as TI-complete by Grochow and Qiao. This packet supplies the square-zero reduction used in the new promise results.

GP-0818.result: All-length finite test when the source is a shift followed by a unary map.

GP-0998.result: Variable-prime hardness at constant incidence width and fixed-field bounds.

GP-0110; GP-0118.result: Exact equivalence of the two universal MaxCut conjectures.

GP-0147.result: An exact factorial transporter field degree for an explicit family of rational orthogonal tensors.

GP-0170.result: A scalar obstruction for literal bilinear-form recovery over fields larger than three.
